Fama/French research factors

Source: R/data.r
fama_french.Rd

Return (factors) and level (risk free rate) time series for the Fama/French asset pricing factors. A snapshot of the factors dataset from the FFresearch package, version 0.0.1.0 (bautheac/FFresearch master, including PR #18), snapshotted 2026-11-14; not built in this package. FFresearch is a build-time dependency only (Suggests): there is no runtime dependency, and no French data is downloaded or parsed here. Rebuild with data-raw/rebuild_fama_french.R.

data(fama_french)

Format

A data.table with variables:

  • region: geographical market considered for factor construction; factor with levels US, developed, developed (ex US), Europe, JP, Asia-Pacific (ex JP), North America.

  • frequency: factor return frequency; factor with levels month, day, year.

  • factor: Fama/French factor; character. One of CMA, HML, LT_Rev, market, Mom, risk free rate, RMW, SMB, ST_Rev, WML.

  • period: period over which factor returns are calculated or risk free rate level is observed; character, YYYYMM (month), YYYYMMDD (day) or YYYY (year).

  • value: corresponding return (factors) or level (risk free rate) observation; numeric.

Source

http://mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/data_library.html.

Details

US factors cover 197101-202609 (monthly), 19710104-20260930 (daily) and 1971-2025 (annual); regional history starts in July 1990 (monthly) or 1991 (annual). FFresearch trimmed every series to a 1971 start in a maintainer decision (2026-11-14, see its docs/verification-spec-3.md); this snapshot follows it.

The FFresearch version used for the snapshot is recorded on the dataset itself: `attr(fama_french, "ffresearch_version")`.
